question.worked_solution:
First, we substitute $h(t)=320$ into the equation:

$$
5\cdot {4}^{3t+6}=320
$$

We can divide both sides of the equation by the constant factor of $5:$

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{5\cdot {4}^{3t+6}}{5} & =\frac{320}{5} \\ \frac{\cancel{5}\cdot {4}^{3t+6}}{\cancel{5}} & =64 \\ {4}^{3t+6} & =64\end{aligned}
$$

Finally, we solve for $t$ using the fact that $64$ is a power of $4:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{4}^{3t+6} & ={4}^{3} \\ 3t+6 & =3 \\ 3t & =-3 \\ t & =-1\end{aligned}
$$
